due_when.clears_when: A pytest-run job summary is OBSERVED naming which modules skipped and why, on a GREEN run -- read off the Checks tab, not reasoned about from the workflow file. !! A PASSING SELF-TEST CLEARS NOTHING: the summariser runs inside pytest-run and a guard-time self-test cannot reach that job's JUnit report. !! AND THE FIRST OBSERVATION MUST ANSWER THE OPEN QUESTION THAT MOTIVATED THIS ROW -- whether tests/test_automerge_request_gate.py is among the skips -- because if it IS, that is a SECOND and more serious finding (a LANDING_MACHINERY guard untested in CI) and this row must not be closed on the reporting fix alone; file that separately. !! IF IT IS NOT among them, record that too: it means node is present on the runner and the concern was unfounded, which is a real result and must be written down rather than left looking like an open worry.
